phabtaskgraph-desc: Ku muuji xidhiidhada hawlaha Phabricator garaaf xoog ku hagaya
phabtaskgraph-tasks-field-help: Liis aqoonsiyada hawlaha oo comma lagu kala saaray (ku bilaabashada "T" waa ikhtiyaari); tusaale ahaan, 'T123456, T654321'
phabtaskgraph-projects-field-help: Liis magacyada mashaariicda oo comma lagu kala saaray; tusaale ahaan, 'MediaWiki-Platform-Team, Epic'
